title: v5.4.2 — Soft-Lock Fix, Auto Cache Clear, Desktop Centering & Extras Menu
message: Major reliability pass. Whenever you update to a newer version, all stale caches are cleared automatically and you'll see a brief 'Updated to vX.X.X' notice. A 20-frame guardian runs on every app launch — if a menu was scroll-locked from a previous session but isn't actually open anymore, the lock is released so you can scroll again (no more wiping app data to recover). The onboarding screen no longer leaves a phantom scroll lock when dismissed. Desktop layout now uses bulletproof flex centering — content stays in the middle of wide screens instead of slamming to one side. Achievement notifications now show the friendly name and icon (e.g. '🛡️ Playing it Safe — Enable Safe Mode') instead of the raw id. Safe Mode moved from the top of Settings into a new ✨ Extras submenu — out of sight unless you want it. Cache name bumped so service workers reload cleanly.
